scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:rust && pnpm build:ci
scripts.//build:ci: What a static host builds: the wasm binaries are committed, and neither Go nor Rust exists on the build machine.
scripts.build:wasm: cd go && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../public/main.wasm
scripts.//build:rust: Two binaries from one source: the vectorised kernel and its scalar control.
scripts.build:rust: cd rust && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128" cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir target/simd && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir target/scalar && cp target/simd/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/mandel.wasm ../public/mandel-simd.wasm && cp target/scalar/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/mandel.wasm ../public/mandel-scalar.wasm
